description: Use when the agent you want to settle with is on the OTHER chain (you are on Base with USDC, they are on Robinhood Chain, or the reverse): returns the transactions that move your stablecoin to the settlement chain with the Relay intents bridge (USDC from Base arrives as USDG on Robinhood Chain, USDG arrives as USDC on Base). A Bull agreement lives on one chain, default the seller's, so the seller is paid natively. Bull never touches the bridge funds and the recipient is always YOUR OWN address. Send the steps from your wallet, then poll bull_bridge_status, and only after it is confirmed open the agreement on the settlement chain (bull_agreement_from_template with chain and asset usdc or usdg). Also supports asset "eth": native ETH on Base <-> native ETH on Robinhood Chain (one transaction carrying the ETH value; check that its value is at most your amount and its target is a bridge router, not a Bull address), so you can fund an ETH agreement on the settlement chain or top up gas. Mixed routes: fromAsset / toAsset ("eth" or "stable") let you pay with whatever you hold (ETH -> stable, stable -> ETH) while the seller still gets the agreement's asset; that is a Relay SWAP with slippage and a third party filling it (Bull refuses output under 93% of the input value in USD, wrong output currency, any recipient but you, and unknown approve spenders). Third-party bridge: adds trust and latency, experimental, not tested end to end. Public, no signature. Not for agents already on the same chain.

amount.description: Whole-unit amount: USDC/USDG like "25" (max 10000), or whole ETH like "0.01" when asset is "eth" (same USD caps, about $1 to $10000).

asset.description: "usdc_usdg" (default: Base USDC <-> Robinhood USDG) or "eth" (native ETH on Base <-> native ETH on Robinhood Chain; experimental, not tested live; try a tiny amount). Ignored when fromAsset / toAsset are given.

fromAsset.description: What you spend on fromChain: "eth" or "stable" (USDC on Base, USDG on Robinhood). With a different toAsset this is a SWAP route (Relay): slippage and fees apply, Bull refuses quotes that return under 93% of the input value in USD. amount is in whole units of fromAsset. Experimental.

fromChain.description: Chain your funds are on now: "base" (USDC) or "robinhood" (USDG).

toAsset.description: What must arrive on toChain: "eth" or "stable" (the asset the agreement is denominated in). ETH->stable and stable->ETH are mixed routes.

toChain.description: Settlement chain, where the Bull agreement will be opened (default: the seller's chain): "robinhood" or "base". Must differ from fromChain.

user.description: YOUR wallet. It sends the bridge transactions and receives the funds. The recipient is always this address.

name: bull_bridge_quote
